scoring.summary: Four stages, run in order. Stage 1 reads the market to set how much to trade. Stage 2 removes anything that fails a hard filter. Stage 3 scores survivors 0-100 on factors weighted by research strength. Stage 4 ranks by score x reward-to-risk and sizes each trade so a stop-out costs a fixed slice of the account.
stages: 1. Regime: SPY above its 50- and 200-day averages = risk-on (up to 5 positions, 1% account risk each). Otherwise risk-off (up to 3 positions, 0.5% risk each).
2. Hard filters (below). A stock failing any one is excluded, whatever its score.
3. Score 0-100 from the five weighted parts in the table.

4. Final rank = score x min(R:R, 3) / 3: setups at 3R or better rank on score alone, weaker R:R scales the score down. Flagged actionable only if score >= 70 and within the regime's position count. Allocation = risk per trade / stop distance, capped at 25% of the account.
filters: Price above a RISING 200-day average (200-day MA higher than 20 sessions ago)
A defined stop: structural stop no more than 10% below price
At least 260 trading days of history

components.name: Trend & relative strength
components.rule: Half: price / 52-week high (75% or less scores 0, at the high scores 1). Half: 6-month return skipping the last month, minus SPY's (-10% or worse scores 0, +30% or better scores 1).

components.name: Entry location
components.rule: Distance from the 20-day MA in ATR(14) units. -0.5 to +1.0 ATR scores 1 (a pullback or tight base); fades to 0 at -1.5 ATR (breaking down) and at +3 ATR (stretched). Halved if the 20-day MA is falling.

components.name: Reward-to-risk
components.rule: Stop = lowest low of 10 sessions minus 0.25 ATR (at least 1 ATR below price). Target = 52-week high if it is 1.5-4 ATR above price; capped at price + 4 ATR if further (a swing rarely travels more); price + 3 ATR if the high is closer than 1.5 ATR. R:R of 1.5 or less scores 0; 3 or more scores 1.

components.name: Catalyst & confirmation
components.rule: 40%: share of the last 20 days' volume on up-days (30% scores 0, 70% scores 1). 30%: analyst consensus scaled by coverage, halved if the average target is below price. 30%: a gap-up of 3%+ on 1.5x volume in the last 20 sessions that price still holds.

components.name: Timing signal
components.rule: One third each, if within the last 3 sessions: MACD histogram crossed above 0; RSI(14) crossed above 50; close crossed above the 10-day MA. Lowest weight: these time an entry, they don't predict returns.

scoring.caveat: A screen, not advice. Earnings dates and sector concentration are NOT checked: confirm no earnings report falls inside your holding period and hold at most two names per sector. Prices are end-of-day; recheck levels before placing orders. Weights are a research-informed starting point, not backtested settings.
